ns2:course.label: Food Processing I
ns2:course.description: Principles, unit operations, and applications of food preservation and processing by high temperature, refrigeration, and freezing processes; includes heat transfer, kinetics, chemical and microbial changes in food as a result of processing. Prerequisite: FSHN 418 and FSHN 460; and FSHN 414 or equivalent; FSHN 260 is recommended.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FSHN 418 and FSHN 460; and FSHN 414 or equivalent; FSHN 260 is recommended.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
